component: Independent image-based contour measurement under reconstruction
status: Independent image-only energies, colors, initialized clipped records, invalid-coverage flags and raw node gradients match all initial and stateful native corpora exactly.
boundary: Prepared engine-format premultiplied BGRA pixels, completed region labels and shared contour geometry. This is the image-based measurement term before geometric priors and final border-gradient constraints.
state: Retain original pixel-color cache between evaluations. Original setup initializes each pixel from its completed segmentation region color. Each evaluation rebuilds clipped contour records and updates covered pixel colors; do not silently reinitialize the cache from labels on every evaluation.
record: Preserve original region/sample iteration order, double contour/grid intersections, float32 stored coordinates/perimeter parameters/turn angles, pixel corner insertion, removal of short region runs, signed area and parent correction rules, and original invalid-coverage behavior.
energy: Normalize byte channels and subtract cached colors in float32. Square each float32 residual in double, add B then G then R then A in native order, add to the double row-major accumulator, then multiply by 0.5. The decompiler incorrectly suggests float32 accumulation.
gradient: Normalize colors and subtract parent/reference channels in float32; compute the four-channel dot product, factor 0.5, interpolation Jacobian, products and gradient accumulation in double. Assembly proves the apparent float casts in decompiler derivative products are misleading.
first_acceptance: Passed: 2802 initial states across three phases, including 15 original post-smoothing pipeline images evaluated in each phase, exact quarter-pixel displacement and near-horizontal directions at exponents -70/-90.
full_acceptance: Prepared image objectives, both controller modes and anti-alias repair callbacks match native corpora. Complete supported-profile smoothing also matches all 2713 original outcomes and all 15 retained pipeline targets, including the recorded native failure represented by a library exception.
completion: Matching this measurement term does not establish full smoothing, curve fitting, export, decoding, classification or GUI parity.
initial_comparison: All 2802 image-only energies, float32 pixel colors, invalid-coverage flags, initialized clipped records and raw double node gradients match exactly across all three phases, including quarter-pixel and near-horizontal directions at exponents -70/-90.
api: createContourImageModel({ width, height, bgra, indices, geometry }) owns prepared pixels, initial pixel-color cache and fixed shared topology. model.evaluate(positions) accepts an explicit flat array or Float64Array with two finite double coordinates per node. Return energy, owned Float64Array gradient, Float32Array colors, Uint8Array flags, and initialized per-pixel record arrays [flags,sample,region,x,y,perimeter,turn]. Evaluate successive coordinates on the same model to retain native cache state.
angle_precision: Native FPATAN leaves an extended angle register through FSUB, while storing a separately rounded double angle for the next edge. Independent fixed-point evaluation preserves an extended significand before that subtraction and rounds the delta at the original double arithmetic boundary. Do not subtract two already-rounded Math.atan2 doubles, clamp tiny turn values, or omit turn fields from comparisons.
coordinate_precision: Contour/grid intersections remain double until storing x/y and perimeter independently as float32. Compute perimeter from original double coordinates, not from the already-rounded coordinate fields. Native grid index casts select truncation mode.
stateful_acceptance: Passed: 6981 original evaluations across 1425 raw, jittered, repeated, translated and restored-coordinate sequences. All 3272031 initialized records across initial and sequential corpora match. Exactly 652 sequences retain a different energy after restoring initial coordinates.
perimeter_precision: Stored turn values are float32, but corner-direction subtraction and addition of the double 2*pi constant remain double. A float32 wrap can choose the opposite perimeter on folded contours; phase-2 sourceObjective 2217 retains this regression.
invalid_region_selection: Clear the invalid-region set at each energy evaluation. Add regions whose full contour turn differs from 2*pi by more than 0.001. Invalid pixel coverage adds every current region identifier, including an inserted nesting background. The callback repairs sorted identifiers and clears this set. All 2850 original selections match exactly, including 274 nonempty sets.

native_fragment_capacity.unit: Contiguous same-region polygon fragment groups per measured pixel, including an inserted parent/background group.
native_fragment_capacity.witness: At full-stage case 775, initial PRNG state 4789, phase 2 has 11 fragment groups at pixel (2,2). Native writes beyond ten identifier/weight entries, corrupts its count word to 1315640065 and faults at 0x486b6d.
native_fragment_capacity.independent_response: One packed numeric record preserves overlapping scratch fields and native operation order. Completed overflow cases retain exact results; the recorded invalid access becomes a JavaScript exception. No unconditional fragment-count guard is imposed.
native_fragment_capacity.status: Native memory layout recovered and independently compared; ten fragments is not a valid safe-domain rejection threshold.

native_fragment_scratch.status: Implemented and verified against captured native fields, all established image corpora and complete smoothing outcomes.
native_fragment_scratch.layout: One little-endian numeric record for original model offsets 0x78..0xf7. IDs begin at relative 0, float64 weights at relative 0x28, signed count at relative 0x78 and signed background at relative 0x7c. Views overlap; writes and subsequent reads retain native order. Reset only count/background for each nonempty pixel, preserving other scratch bytes.
native_fragment_scratch.behavior: Use the aliased count for append/index loops and the aliased background for gradient preparation. Retain original one-past-count weight subtraction in the parentless/background branch. Do not impose a fragment-count rejection: benign overflowing native cases remain valid reference results. Actual out-of-record or invalid-region accesses become ordinary library exceptions rather than arbitrary process memory access.
native_fragment_scratch.acceptance: Passed exact scratch count/background/identifier/weight fields from native pixel 18, all 2802 initial and 6981 stateful measurements, 2799 combined objectives, 3312 image line searches, 1029 image controllers and 6981 combined objective sequence states. Complete smoothing matches all 2713 original outcomes and all 15 pipeline targets.
